records.name: Booming Blade

rule.adds: Casting it makes one melee attack with a weapon you hold (you choose if you hold several). From 5th level the attack adds 1d8 thunder on a hit (2d8 at 11th, 3d8 at 17th). A target that is hit is sheathed until the start of your next turn: if it moves 5 feet or more of its own will, it takes 1d8 thunder (one more die at 5th, 11th and 17th) and the spell ends. Pushes and pulls by the engine do not set it off.

records.note:
Booming Blade and Green-Flame Blade have no entry: the whole rule is in scripts/blade-cantrips.mjs (Foundry glue) and
scripts/core/blade-cantrips.mjs (pure rules), which recognise the two spells by their identifier.

rule.adds: Casting it makes one melee attack with a weapon you hold. From 5th level the attack adds 1d8 fire on a hit (2d8 at 11th, 3d8 at 17th). On a hit you choose a creature within 5 feet of the target: it takes fire damage equal to your spellcasting modifier, plus the same dice.

records.name: Lightning Lure

rule.adds: On a failed save the target is pulled up to 10 ft toward the caster. The imported item's target (a "0-foot emanation" that never contains anyone) is corrected to one creature.

records.note:
Lightning Lure (TCE p.107, SCAG): a failed save pulls the target up to 10 ft toward the caster. The damage is
left as rolled: the engine applies it wherever the target ends. The imported item gives the save an area of
size zero, so no creature is ever in it: the target is corrected to one creature in the item's data (by the
active GM when the item is created, and by the world diagnostic for items already on a sheet).

records.name: Tasha's Caustic Brew

rule.adds: No damage on the cast; 2d4 acid at the start of each of the target's turns; an action ends it.

records.note:
Tasha's Caustic Brew (TCE p.115): no damage on the cast. The item's data puts the 2d4 on the saving throw: it
is rolled at the start of each of the bearer's turns instead, and the bearer can spend an action to end the
effect.

records.name: Tasha's Mind Whip

rule.adds: No reactions until the end of the target's next turn; on that turn, an action or a bonus action, not both.

records.note:
Tasha's Mind Whip (TCE p.115): the effect takes away its bearer's reactions and holds it to an action OR a
bonus action, and ends at the end of the bearer's turn. Giving both up to move instead is left to the table.
